body.statement: The group \(G_\star\) is the direct product of the symmetric groups on the \(\sim\)-classes. Consequently, for \(K=2\), \(G_\star\cong(S_2)^{\binom{m+1}{2}}\); for \(K\geq3\), \(G_\star\cong S_2\), acting only on \(\{C_+,C_-\}\).
body.justification: This translates the probability partition into the largest schedule-universal transformation group without presupposing the group.
body.gap: \cite{HemerikGoeman2018} establishes exact testing for a specified invariant group; the new input is the maximal group forced by the composite causal null.
body.consumer: It supplies a precise validation target for any software option advertised as a weak-null common-invariance randomization test.
